title: 第404章 PUA田家母女
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“好了，都少说两句。”

方安雅沉声打断两人的争执。

上前拉着还想争辩的杨国珍，径直往院外走：“国珍，你先回去，这事复杂，回头我单独跟你慢慢解释。”

“你真认识她们？”杨国珍目光里全是疑问。

方安雅点了点头，叹了口气。

杨国珍看到方安雅这个表情，知道现在不是追问的时候，便没有再多说什么，只是拉着方安雅的手，用力握了一下。

“行，那我不问了，你要有什么事，直接来我家找我，我不在的话就去街道办，你别一个人扛着。”

方安雅心里一暖，“好。”

杨国珍转身拉开了院门。

门口趴着三个人，两个蹲着，一个半跪着，耳朵贴着门板，姿势一个比一个奇怪。

杨国珍突然出来，三个人躲闪不及，一个撞一个，稀里哗啦地摔了进来。

空气凝固了一瞬。

李大姐从地上爬起来，脸上堆出一个极不自然的笑，仰头望了望天：“哎呀，这天好像要下雨了。”

“对对对，我家衣服还晾在外面没收呢！”

“我也是我也是，炉子上还坐着水呢，别烧干了。”

三个人作鸟兽散，走得比兔子还快。

杨国珍瞪了那几个仓皇逃窜的背影一眼，回头安抚方安雅：“放心，这些人我回头帮你敲打敲打，不许她们在外头乱嚼舌根、传闲话。”

说完便转身离开了。

方安雅深吸一口气，敛去脸上的温和，冷着脸转身回屋。

田小娥不知道什么时候从房间里出来了，换好了一身干净衣服，头发还湿着，站在客厅，低着头，两只手绞在一起，一副乖顺的模样。

田母还憋着一肚子不服气，兀自嘟囔。

“吵什么？”方安雅压着怒火开口，“是觉得事情不够丢人？要不要我去给你找个大喇叭，站在胡同口喊一圈，告诉所有人，你女儿未婚先孕，上门逼婚？”

田母的嘴巴张了一下，想顶嘴，方安雅没给她机会。

“我跟你们说过没有？这段时间低调点，别出门，别跟外人说话，别惹事。你们是拿我的话当耳旁风吗？”

“小娥未婚先孕的事情要是传出去，对秉轩的工作影响有多大你们知不知道？”

"Okay, just say a few words."

Fang Anya interrupted the argument between the two in a deep voice.

He stepped forward and pulled Yang Guozhen, who was still wanting to argue, and walked straight out of the hospital: "Guozhen, you go back first. This matter is complicated. I will explain it to you slowly later."

"Do you really know them?" Yang Guozhen's eyes were full of questions.

Fang Anya nodded and sighed.

Seeing Fang Anya's expression, Yang Guozhen knew that now was not the time to ask further questions, so she didn't say anything more. She just took Fang Anya's hand and shook it hard.

"Okay, I won't ask anymore. If you need anything, just come to my house to find me. If I'm not here, go to the street to handle it. Don't carry it alone."

Fang Anya felt warm in her heart, "Okay."

Yang Guozhen turned around and opened the courtyard door.

There were three people lying at the door, two squatting and one half-kneeling, with their ears pressed against the door panel. Each one's posture was weirder than the last.

Yang Guozhen suddenly came out, and the three of them couldn't dodge. They bumped into each other and fell in with a loud crash.

The air froze for a moment.

Sister Li got up from the ground, with an unnatural smile on her face, and looked up at the sky: "Oh, it seems like it's going to rain today."

"Yes, yes, my clothes are still hanging outside and confiscated!"

"Me too, me too. There's still water sitting on the stove. Don't let it boil dry."

The three people scattered like birds and beasts, walking faster than rabbits.

Yang Guozhen glared at the hurriedly fleeing figures, then turned back to comfort Fang Anya: "Don't worry, I'll go back and help you beat these people, don't allow them to gossip or spread gossip outside."

After saying that, he turned around and left.

Fang Anya took a deep breath, wiped away the gentleness on her face, and turned back to the house with a cold face.

Tian Xiao'e came out of the room at some point. She changed into clean clothes and her hair was still wet. She stood in the living room with her head lowered and her hands twisted together, looking obedient.

Tian's mother was still holding back her dissatisfaction and muttered to herself.

"What are you arguing about?" Fang Anya suppressed her anger and said, "Do you think the matter is not embarrassing enough? Do you want me to find you a loudspeaker, stand in the alley and shout around, telling everyone that your daughter got pregnant before marriage and came to your door to force you to marry?"

Tian's mother opened her mouth and wanted to talk back, but Fang Anya didn't give her a chance.

"Did I tell you? Keep a low profile during this period. Don't go out, don't talk to outsiders, and don't cause trouble. Are you turning a deaf ear to what I say?"

"If word spreads about Xiao'e's pregnancy out of wedlock, do you know how much impact it will have on Bingxuan's work?"
